import math
def control(obs):
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    cam=obs['views'].get('camera')
    if not cam:
        return (0,0,-41)
    th=math.radians(-h)
    sides=[[],[]]
    for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
        a=math.radians(b)
        x=d*math.cos(a); y=d*math.sin(a)
        s=-x*math.cos(th)-y*math.sin(th)
        q=-x*math.sin(th)+y*math.cos(th)
        if 1<s<14:
            sides[0 if q>0 else 1].append((s,q))
    look=7.0
    vals=[]
    for pts in sides:
        if not pts: continue
        weights=[math.exp(-((s-look)/3.0)**2) for s,q in pts]
        sw=sum(weights)
        ms=sum(w*s for w,(s,q) in zip(weights,pts))/sw
        mq=sum(w*q for w,(s,q) in zip(weights,pts))/sw
        den=sum(w*(s-ms)**2 for w,(s,q) in zip(weights,pts))
        slope=sum(w*(s-ms)*(q-mq) for w,(s,q) in zip(weights,pts))/max(den,0.01)
        vals.append(mq+slope*(look-ms))
    if len(vals)!=2:
        return (h,0,-41)
    y=sum(vals)/2
    hd=max(-38,min(38,math.degrees(math.atan2(2*10.2*y,look*look))))
    feed=math.degrees(math.atan(3.9/10.2*math.sin(math.radians(h))))
    steer=max(-42,min(42,feed+1.4*(h-hd)))
    return (steer,-0.45,-41)

    da=v*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))/3.9*dt
    c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da)
    if line is not None:
        x,y,dx,dy=line
        x-=v*dt
        line=(c*x+s*y,-s*x+c*y,c*dx+s*dy,-s*dx+c*dy)
    cam=obs['views'].get('camera')

    for b,d in cam.get('target_corners',[]):
        a=math.radians(b)
        pts.append((ox+d*math.cos(a),oy+d*math.sin(a)))
    pairs=[]
    for i,p in enumerate(pts):

            width=math.hypot(ax,ay)

    th=math.radians(-h)

    rx=x-ox; ry=y-oy
    along=-rx*ct-ry*st
